color.bg.sunken.description: Wells inside a card: tracks, notes, segmented controls, hover rows.

color.bg.raised.description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, drawers (pair with elevation.raised/overlay).

color.bg.overlay.description: Scrim behind modal dialogs and drawers.

color.text.disabled.description: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast (WCAG 1.4.3).

color.text.on-accent.description: Text on accent.solid (current nav item, badges).

color.border.subtle.description: Dividers between rows and sections. Decorative, not a boundary.

color.border.default.description: Control outlines: inputs, selects, filter pills (>= 3:1).

color.border.focus.description: Focus ring and focused control outline (>= 3:1).

color.accent.solid.description: The one primary action; the current nav item.

color.accent.soft.description: Selected tabs, secondary buttons, counts, icon tiles.

color.status.neutral.bg.description: Neutral status: tags, neutral status pills.

color.status.neutral.border.description: Decorative ring around a neutral tag (not a boundary).

color.skeleton.base.description: Loading placeholder shapes. Decorative (no contrast requirement).

color.skeleton.highlight.description: The other end of the skeleton pulse.

font.family.sans.description: Everything: UI, body, headings. Self-hosted variable font (weights 200-800).
font.family.sans.value: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Plus Jakarta Sans Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

font.family.mono.description: Employee numbers, codes, dates and counts; pair with tabular numerals.
font.family.mono.value: 'Geist Mono', 'Geist Mono Fallback', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

radius.lg.description: Inner panels, list rows, menus, notes.

radius.pill.description: Buttons, filters, tabs, status pills, avatars.

icon-size.sm.description: Inside buttons, pills and meta lines.

easing.standard.description: Default for state changes and exits.

easing.emphasized.description: Overlays entering: a slight, spring-like settle. Never for colour changes.

breakpoint.narrow.description: Phones: dialogs and drawers go full screen, data tables switch to card mode, toasts span the width.

breakpoint.compact.description: Tablets and small laptops: the app-shell sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer.

focus.ring.color.description: Resolves per theme (this file is part of both theme builds).

control.sm.height.description: Compact controls: small buttons, row actions, chips.

control.md.height.description: Default height for buttons, inputs, selects and filter pills, so they line up.

control.lg.height.description: Prominent single actions: the sign-in button.

layout.topbar.height.description: App-shell top bar (search, actions, user menu).

layout.content.max-width.description: Page content width inside the app shell: the 1200px direction-d frame minus the sidebar, with room to breathe at 1440.

size.dialog.lg.description: Dialogs with a form or a table.

size.drawer.md.description: Default side sheet (create and edit forms).

size.drawer.lg.description: Wide side sheet (permission matrix, long forms).

elevation.card.description: Cards and chips resting on the canvas.

elevation.focus.description: Outer glow for a focused text field (with border.focus outline).
